# snipeit_group (Data Source)

Looks up a single permission group by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_group" "helpdesk" {
  name = "Helpdesk"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the group. Set it to look up by id.
- `name` (String) Name of the group. Set it to look up by exact name.

### Read-Only

- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `permissions` (Map of String) Permission map stored for the group.
